document.abstract: This standard describes the data format for the interchange of a list of audio/video content decisions which specify an audio/video product. Exchange of this information allows the audio/video product to be reproduced on a compatible editing system. Such a list is commonly referred to as an edit decision list. The transfer medium and storage format are not specified in this standard.
